utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Dane — we’re meeting by the community shed at nine, sorting the tools first, then splitting up, and I’m bringing the extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late to the planning—thanks for lining that up, and I can jump in wherever you need me once we get started.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s alright, Dane — if you can be at the shed by nine, I’d like you to help sort the tools first so we can keep the plan moving cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive after school drop-off, as long as I’m free again by pickup around 2:45 to 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—Leo said Saturday at 10 in his driveway, and I think the main fixes left are the bench, the fence panel, and that bus stop light.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 works for me, and I should be fine until pickup as long as we wrap by about 2:30.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 10 in my driveway—bring any small appliances or tools that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo—I’ll bring my drill and a couple extra screwdrivers, and I can help folks with the smaller fixes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, Gus—bring them along and help with the small fixes when people start arriving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll start by sorting the donated tools and setting aside the ones that are still in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam—that helps a lot. Once you’ve sorted them, let me know what’s usable so I can match the tools to volunteers for Maple Street by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do—I’ll sort them this afternoon and let you know what’s usable for Maple Street by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I tell anyone anything, can we double-check whether Saturday’s final and if the confirmed repairs are still just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: As far as I know, yes—Saturday’s still the plan, and the only confirmed jobs are the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — I’ll hold off on spreading the word until Jules confirms the final okay and we’ve checked there isn’t a third repair already on the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally—check the supplies first, and if it looks good tonight I’ll start inviting the whole block right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the bins now and let you know if we’ve got enough screws, tape, gloves, and a small screwdriver set before you spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—just send me the word once you’ve checked, and I’ll start inviting everyone tonight if we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, I agree—we need one shared list first, so can you set that up and mark each repair by urgency and tool type today?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can start the shared list, but before we lock anything in, I really want a headcount and a clear note on who’s bringing which tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—set up the list today anyway, and add columns for volunteer count and who’s bringing which tools; once that’s in, what’s still missing for you to triage the first batch?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira—I’m still out running errands, but how’s the repair drive shaping up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: It sounds promising, but can we confirm the headcount and who’s bringing tools before we call it settled?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, let’s pin that down first—I’m still out, but keep me posted once the headcount and tool list are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, the repair drive’s going well so far—we’ve got a good turnout, and I’ve been telling everyone it’s moving along nicely.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great to hear, Vik — I’m really glad folks are showing up. I’m still waiting on the final okay for next Saturday at the community center lot, and then I’ll share the exact time so you can keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Jules — once you’ve got the final okay and time, I’ll keep spreading the word so everyone’s clear on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I can sort the donated parts. Just point me to the boxes, and I’ll try not to mix anything up this time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Oren, that’d be a real help—the boxes are by the folding table, and if you keep the hand tools separate from the spare parts, Eli says the whole drive will run smoother.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, by the folding table. I can do that, and if we still need more volunteers for Saturday, I can ask around too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, we’re still meeting by the community shed this weekend, and I’m bringing the signup sheet plus a box of basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—do you know which repairs are first on the list, or where we still need people?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m starting with the wobbly bikes and the lamp rewiring, and we could really use a couple more hands on the bike side.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Nell, I’ve got the repair drive marked for Maple Street by the community garden, with the community center lot as our meetup spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps a lot—I’d only heard bits and pieces. So it’s Saturday by the community garden, meeting at the community center lot?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that’s right—Saturday on Maple Street by the community garden, and we’re meeting in the community center lot first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Skimming this—what’s left, the bench, fence panel, and that Cedar bus stop light, and we’re still doing Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, and we’ve still got the bench, the fence panel, and that Cedar bus stop light left—I’ve been telling folks that’s the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I'll be there Saturday at 10, and we can start with whichever of those needs me first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — the repair drive is on Maple Street by the community garden, and I’m gathering the final list this week if there’s anything you want me to add.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — please add me as a helper after school drop-off, but I’ll need to be clear of pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Faye — I’ll put you down for the after-drop-off window and make sure we wrap your shift before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—Sam, do we still need more volunteers for Saturday, or should I just bring my toolbox and sort parts where you need me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Bring your toolbox and come by Saturday at 9—we can always use another set of hands, and I’ll get you sorting parts once Gus has us set up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right—9 o’clock, got it. I’ll bring the toolbox and stick with sorting parts once Gus gets us set up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, I’m lining up the repair drive for next Saturday at the community center lot if the final okay comes through this afternoon—would you be up for helping or spreading the word once I confirm the time?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can help spread the word—though I thought we were still meeting by the community shed, so just let me know once that’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah—that helps a lot. I’m waiting on the final okay this afternoon, and as soon as they confirm whether it’s the community center lot or the shed, I’ll send you the right details to share.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, we’re still meeting by the community shed this weekend, and I’ll bring the signup sheet and a box of basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good—that should help keep things organized. I’m still out running errands, but keep me posted on how the repair drive’s shaping up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do—I’ll let you know if anything shifts, but for now we’re still set for the community shed this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Leo, it’s coming together fast for Saturday, and I’m telling everyone to swing by—if you’re in, I’ll loop you in on the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in—Saturday at 10 in my driveway. Tell folks to bring any small appliances or tools that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo—I’ll spread the word tonight and make sure everyone knows to bring their small appliances and tools to your driveway at 10 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s coming together, slowly. A few folks said they can help, and Gus is bringing some tools, so we’re keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it—I’m happy to pitch in wherever you need me, and I can start helping set things up if that makes things easier.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Nell, it’s coming together nicely—folks keep stopping by to ask how they can pitch in. I’m hearing a lot of good energy around the block.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to hear—I’d only heard bits and pieces, so do you know if it’s still this Saturday morning at the community lot?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, this Saturday morning at the community lot, and it sounds like we’ll be in good shape—tools have been coming in all morning, and Sam may even set up a spare-parts table.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, what’s the actual status right now—how many volunteers are confirmed, and who’s owning the tool drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Right now I’ve got Sam and Uli confirmed, and I’m handling the tool drop-off spot myself with my drill and spare screwdrivers at the lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—put that in one shared list today, and how many repair requests are actually logged so we can match Sam and Uli to the right jobs?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Hana — we’re meeting by the community shed at nine to sort tools, and I’m bringing the extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — before I pass that along, can I check whether the shed meetup at nine is fully confirmed, or are we still waiting on Jules’s final okay for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: As far as I know, nine at the shed is the plan, but let’s treat it as pending until Jules gives the final okay for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo—that helps a lot. Let me know what you find about the screwdriver set this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do—I’ve already got a pair of work gloves set aside for you, and I’ll check the supply bin for that small screwdriver set this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo—I appreciate it. The gloves will help, and just let me know if the screwdriver set turns up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, I’ve got the repair drive marked for Maple Street by the community garden, and the three fixes still on my list are the Maple Park bench, the loose fence panel behind the garden, and the flickering bus stop light on Cedar.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can we confirm the headcount and who’s bringing which tools before we call the repair drive settled?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—I've got the location pinned, and before we call it settled I want to confirm the headcount and make sure each stop has the right tools assigned.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard about a few small fixes so far—leaky faucets and a broken fence latch. Do you know what the first priority is for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah—the plan is to meet by the community shed at nine, sort the tools, and then split up, so I’ve been telling everyone that’s our first priority before we tackle the faucets and fence latch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I’ll plan on the shed at nine, then. I can help sort tools, and I’m still hoping we’ve got enough screwdrivers and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What’s still on the list again—bench, fence, and that bus stop light?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that sounds right—sorry I’m late again; where do you want me to jump in first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, those three—start with the fence behind the community garden, and we’ll figure the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely set on the repair drive, and can you confirm who’s actually coming and what tools they’re bringing first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I know we’re still set and meeting by the community shed, but I don’t trust myself on who’s bringing what—Hana’s been keeping the details straighter than me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, then before we call it settled, can you check with Hana and confirm the headcount and who’s bringing which tools?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still on board, but before we lock it in I really want a firm headcount and one shared list with someone assigned to sort repairs by urgency and tool needs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That makes sense—I can keep the shared list and tag each repair by urgency and tool needs, and I’ll note Pia as pending once we confirm the headcount.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot, thank you—once we’ve confirmed who’s coming and who’s bringing tools, I’ll feel much better about saying yes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, I’m still out running errands, but how’s the repair drive shaping up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s coming together well—I’m set to be at the lot Saturday at 9 with my toolbox, and I’ll help sort the donated tools and tackle the small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great, Sam—thanks for pitching in Saturday at 9. I’m still out, but keep me posted, especially once the tool drop-off spot gets locked in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa, I’m still checking the supply bin, but I know we’ve got spare screws, tape, and some gloves on hand for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a great start, Cleo—thank you. When you finish checking, send me the full list so I can match supplies to the Maple Street setup by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do—I’ll send you the full list once I finish checking this afternoon, and I’ll flag anything Maple Street still needs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say for sure, can we check how many volunteers are already on the list for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll check the volunteer list for Saturday and then I’ll let you know who’s already in before I keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn—that helps; once you’ve checked, can you also confirm whether we only have the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence listed so far, or if there’s a third repair already confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far—what’s the latest on the repair drive, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s shaping up nicely—Saturday at 9 at the lot, and I’ve already got a stack of small fixes lined up plus my drill and extra screwdrivers ready to share.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps a lot—Saturday at 9 at the lot, got it. I’ll pass that along since I’d only been hearing bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, it’s shaping up nicely—we’re planning for next Saturday at the community center lot, just waiting on the final okay this afternoon before I share the exact time around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine, Jules—once you get the final okay, send me the time and I’ll help keep everyone on the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Eli—I really appreciate that. I’ll send you the time as soon as it’s confirmed so you can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Leo, it’s coming together nicely—Sam’s set to sort the donated tools this afternoon, and folks keep asking how they can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—tell them Saturday at 10 in my driveway, and ask them to bring any small appliances or tools that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect, Leo—I’ll pass around that it’s Saturday at 10 in your driveway, and I’ll tell folks to bring any small appliances or tools that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school drop-off, but I need to be clear for pickup later, so that morning window works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, got it—I'll put you down for the morning, around 9:30 to 1:30, and that helps a ton.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Oren—that window should work well for me as long as I can head out in time for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mina, we’re still meeting by the community shed this weekend, and I’m bringing the signup sheet and a box of basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—how many names are already on the signup sheet, and is the community shed definitely the tool drop-off spot now?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I haven’t counted the names since I’m still bringing the sheet, but yes—the community shed is definitely the drop-off spot.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
